facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 70°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 1 nearby station in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) 19 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: May 12 (2024), May 14 (2025); 2023: no readings on file

facts.text: At Harkness Flat (6,200 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.9 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: 1.9 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 28.5 in (2024), 33.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 2 and May 22, carried from the melt-out dates at Harkness Flat (6,200 ft) and Blacks Mountain (7,050 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Harkness Flat
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 250 ft below the pass; points to April 5 to May 22

evidence.name: Blacks Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out May 6, 600 ft above the pass; points to March 31 to May 21
